# pipe write

Write a RAPID channel path without taking automation authority.

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Stable ID | `statement.pipe_write` |
| Origin | DCode |
| Category | Statements |
| Family | Channel I/O |
| Monaco kind | `statement` |
| Format | `\|portal/channel.field\| = <expression>` |
| Valid contexts | `executable`, `file` |
| Autocomplete | `\|portal/channel.value\| = value` |

## Example
